title: Four Months Ago I Made The Life-Changing Decision To....
author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
selftext:
Hey everyone, my name is Mart. Four months ago I made the life-changing decision to officially NOT quit my job and spend my free time using mostly generative AI to help build my dream game. I present to you Time Synchers.

Travel through space and time capturing the most unique fish the multiverse has to offer. This is meant to be the side chick of video games. We all have our main games, I just want mine open on your second monitor. Fish between matches, idle while you work, or actively grind because brain crack, numbers go up, blah blah blah. It’s fishing, grinding, farming, dueling, collector’s mania. Fill your album, upgrade your gear, and spend hours hunting extremely rare fish and variants so you can flex on people who didn’t ask.

The prototype is available November 2nd – November 9th 2026. You can make an account or jump in as a guest. I’ve been staring at it for four months and need someone else to tell me what’s fun and what sucks.

[TimeSynchers.com](https://timesynchers.com)

comments.author: EggplantMiserable559
comments.body:
Actively blocking mobile for a web game is a bad call. Then blocking guest signup despite it being on the main menu is worse.

Not gonna try a third attempt for now. 🤷‍♂️

replies.author: Shleepy1
replies.body: Yeah, no mobile… then it’s not for me atm/

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Cant play as guest even though the options is there?

comments.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
comments.body: Working on fixing the guest accounts, had it disabled for private testing. Should be good to go.

comments.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
comments.body: Guest accounts are officially fixed. Feel free to fish anonymously !

comments.author: Fit_Eye_3564
comments.body: Theres too much going on. I tried a sa guest and the long intro really disinterested me. The idea sounds fun, but I dropped it because it isnt very user friendly

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback, the intro only serves as a little lore background and I added a skip button just for that reason. I’d love to improve on being user friendly, anything in particular I could work on?

replies.author: StandardCategory5153
replies.body:
Bro.... learn what ONBOARDING for FTUE (First Time User Experience) is...

You have all these systems... roll them out over time.... start DEAD simple to a first time user. Reduce it all, get it to the MVP (minimum viable product) then drip feed new systems.

Also reduce all text to be succinct. Like remove 60% of all your words at least.

No one cares about your lore UNTIL they are invested in the game. You hook them then you let them consume more.

I'm a profesional game designer who has lead multiple commericially successful games. Take my feedback or don't :)

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: I will absolutely take your feedback! This is my first time hearing about FTUE, so that’s something I can dive into and really work on. I’d really appreciate more feedback if your not opposed to suffering a few more minutes, I could really use the advise. 😅

replies.author: StandardCategory5153
replies.body: Thats as far as I got... was overwhelmed and dipped out. Fix it up and DM me. :)

comments.author: drahgon
comments.body: bro I immediately lost interest. Wayyy too much going on. Feels like a mess. Liked the brainrot button but when I couldnt figure out what to do in 5 seconds I quit

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: I agree, onboarding seems like a very apparent change I need to make. I appreciate the feedback, like I said I’ve been looking at this game for months so these things all just passed my mind. Will work on fixing these!

replies.author: drahgon
replies.body: Yeah, you need to actually play this game from the start as if you were a new user and you had no idea what was going on. And ask yourself does this make sense? Do I know what to do next etc.

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: Refreshing perspective, seems like I was just to excited to share all the features I forgot how to drip feed the player

replies.author: Brain_Crackd_Studios
replies.body: Im ready to show my new and improved version if you are down?
